gap: No result ChatGPT got puts both collecting mowers on the same footing with the collector fitted. Both bags hold the same amount (ANTHBOT N8 23 L built in, Mammotion YUKA sweeper 22 L add-on). The N8 keeps its 45% (24°) slope rating with the bag on, while the YUKA falls to 18% (10°). Mammotion's own spec sheet gives 28° without the sweeper and 18% with it, two different units in one table. And the 1,500 m² 'lawn size' both makers quote is not what the N8 covers per charge with the bag on: Notebookcheck measured about 200 m², so 0.37 acre takes about 7–8 charges.
standout_why: Pages compared: Notebookcheck YUKA review (cited) and T3 YUKA review (2024, in results, not cited) both give the YUKA as 45% without the sweeper and 18% with it. PCWorld N8 (cited) gives 24°/45% (not tested), quotes ANTHBOT's 'about 2,150 sq ft continuous mowing with the grass catcher' and measured 68 dB. Notebookcheck N8 (in results, not cited) measured about 200 m² per charge and about 70 dB. T3 N8 (cited) has 23 L and 44.5% (24°). NeoIntell and MowerBotLab have no slope, capacity or per-charge figures for consumer collecting mowers. Rivals hold the separate pieces. None puts them side by side in one unit with the collector on: equal bags, 24° vs 10°, rated area vs area per charge. ChatGPT's table listed the YUKA's capacity only as 'Sweeper basket', with no litre figure.
decides: This confirms the N8 pick and makes the reason something you can measure. With the collector fitted, the two bags hold the same, so capacity doesn't separate them. Slope does: the N8 keeps 24° while the YUKA drops to 10°, so any sloped lawn rules out the YUKA when it is collecting. The N8 also includes its collector in the $1,359 price, while the YUKA needs a separately bought sweeper (combo $2,048 vs $1,399 solo in T3's 2024 US prices). Footnote for the page: '0.37 acre' is a schedule capacity, not one run. With the bag on, the N8 measured about 200 m² (about 2,150 sq ft) per charge, and it dumps about every 100 minutes.

findings.source_title: Anthbot N8 robot lawn mower review | T3

findings.label: Noise: maker figure vs measured while collecting
findings.value: Maker: 58 dB (mow/mulch), ≤60 dB standard. Measured collecting: just under 68 dB at 1 m (PCWorld); about 70 dB at 1 m (Notebookcheck)

findings.label: Slope with vs without sweeper (maker spec sheet, units as printed)
findings.note: The sheet mixes units: 28° = tan(28°) = 53%, while 18% = 10.2°. Notebookcheck and T3 instead give 45% (24°) without the sweeper, so the maker's 28° conflicts with both reviewers. With the sweeper on, every source agrees on 18% (10°), less than half the N8's 24°.

findings.value: Max mowing size 1,500 m² (0.37 acre) / 2,000 m² (0.5 acre); 350 m²/h; battery 4.5 Ah without sweeper, 9 Ah with sweeper
findings.note: 350 m²/h is the maker's claim and does not say whether the sweeper is fitted. Notebookcheck measured about 230 m² per charge (just under 2 h) without the sweeper on the YUKA 1000.
